title.vi: Dữ liệu mất cân bằng: vì sao accuracy đánh lừa

summary.vi: baseline Dummy, class_weight, recall/precision lớp hiếm, ngưỡng, lấy mẫu lại
summary.en: Dummy baseline, class_weight, rare-class recall/precision, thresholds, resampling

files.name: main.py
files.code:
from sklearn.datasets import make_classification
from sklearn.dummy import DummyClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

# 5% lớp dương (ví dụ: giao dịch gian lận)
X, y = make_classification(n_samples=4000, n_features=10, n_informative=5,
                           weights=[0.95], flip_y=0.01, class_sep=1.0, random_state=0)
X_tr, X_te, y_tr, y_te = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.3, stratify=y, random_state=0)
print("tỷ lệ dương:", round(y.mean(), 3))

# Baseline "luôn đoán số đông": accuracy cao vô nghĩa
dummy = DummyClassifier(strategy="most_frequent").fit(X_tr, y_tr)
print("Dummy accuracy:", round(accuracy_score(y_te, dummy.predict(X_te)), 3),
      "| recall:", recall_score(y_te, dummy.predict(X_te)))

for cw in [None, "balanced"]:
    m = LogisticRegression(class_weight=cw, max_iter=1000).fit(X_tr, y_tr)
    p = m.predict(X_te)
    print(cw, "| acc:", round(accuracy_score(y_te, p), 3),
          "| precision:", round(precision_score(y_te, p), 2), "| recall:", round(recall_score(y_te, p), 2))

prompt.vi: Với dữ liệu mất cân bằng trong ví dụ, tính accuracy của DummyClassifier(strategy='most_frequent') trên tập kiểm tra (làm tròn 3 chữ số) và recall của nó, mỗi số một dòng.
prompt.en: With the imbalanced data in the example, compute the accuracy of DummyClassifier(strategy='most_frequent') on the test set (rounded to 3 digits) and its recall, one per line.

hint.en: The dummy always predicts 0, so recall = 0.

from sklearn.datasets import make_classification
from sklearn.dummy import DummyClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, recall_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
X, y = make_classification(n_samples=4000, n_features=10, n_informative=5, weights=[0.95], flip_y=0.01, random_state=0)
X_tr, X_te, y_tr, y_te = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.3, stratify=y, random_state=0)
p = DummyClassifier(strategy='most_frequent').fit(X_tr, y_tr).predict(X_te)
print(round(accuracy_score(y_te, p), 3))
print(recall_score(y_te, p))

solution.code:
from sklearn.datasets import make_classification
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import recall_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
X, y = make_classification(n_samples=4000, n_features=10, n_informative=5, weights=[0.95], flip_y=0.01, random_state=0)
X_tr, X_te, y_tr, y_te = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.3, stratify=y, random_state=0)
r0 = recall_score(y_te, LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000).fit(X_tr, y_tr).predict(X_te))
r1 = recall_score(y_te, LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, class_weight='balanced').fit(X_tr, y_tr).predict(X_te))
print(r1 > r0)
